research_protocol.first_principles_rule: Before new external ingestion, state the preliminary model, definitions, premises, units, invariants, unknowns and potential falsifiers. Existing observations may seed the frame; revise premises explicitly when evidence contradicts them. First principles are not a license to invent facts or ignore observations.
research_protocol.deduction: Expose premises, inference rule and scope; a conclusion inherits its unproved assumptions.
research_protocol.induction: Declare sample, selection, uncertainty, confounders, transfer domain and counterexamples; finite measurements do not prove universal claims.
research_protocol.exact_analogy: Map source/target objects, relations, operators and invariant-preservation obligations; distinguish tested instances from a general proof.
research_protocol.approximate_analogy: Declare approximation metric/bound or unknown error, domain and lost invariants; accept transfer only after original-task checks.
research_protocol.ideonomy: Use finite compatibility-filtered combinations of typed primitives only for a named gap/blockage/tradeoff; retain diversity, rejections and a no-useful-candidate outcome.
research_protocol.lacuna: Represent a specific missing observation, mechanism, connection or formal obligation; rank by expected information gain and feasible tests, not by novelty language.
research_protocol.alien_science: Treat alternative notation, axioms, embodiment and representations as explicitly speculative models with operational semantics and human baselines; do not infer alien origin, physical reality or a solved theorem.
research_protocol.non_numeric_fields: Use explicit not_applicable plus rationale where a unit or numeric uncertainty is inapplicable; never fabricate measurements.

representation_lenses.selection_rule: Record applied, not_applicable or deferred with reason, invariant/test and limits for each of the four lenses. Do not force an irrelevant representation.
representation_lenses.simplex: Declare dimensionality, affine/convex assumptions, normalized weights and invariant mappings; normalization is not proof or automatic probabilistic meaning.
representation_lenses.n_ality: Declare arity, typed interactions, composition rules and dimensional constraints; an n-ary structure does not establish physical synergy.
representation_lenses.continuum: Declare domain, boundary/initial conditions, operators and approximation scope; numerical continuum claims need discretization-error, convergence and stability checks.
representation_lenses.fuzzy_logic: Membership degrees are not probabilities. Label semantics, membership functions, aggregation and thresholds; hard authorization and verification gates remain Boolean.
representation_lenses.acceptance: State source/target transformation, invariants and approximation losses, then rerun original-task acceptance tests. A new representation does not change what counts as evidence.
representation_lenses.typed_helpers_status: Implemented in math_lenses.py and required by typed plans; exact OCI package passed116tests. Live adoption is separately measured, not inferred from source.

implementation_scope.simplex: Bounded standard-simplex validation and convex blend; arbitrary vertices do not imply affine independence.
implementation_scope.n_ality: Independently typed geometric dimension, state dimension, logical channels and temporal parameters. This is a reference signature, not a complete n-ary interaction engine.
implementation_scope.continuum: Declared bounded piecewise-linear interpolation, no extrapolation. General continuum IR, PDE convergence and native geometry integration remain source-review/integration tasks.
implementation_scope.fuzzy_logic: Bounded ramp membership and explicit min/max operators; not calibrated probabilities or authorization.

Exact/approximate analogy mappings preserve declared invariants within scope and pass original acceptance tests.
Reported, observed, simulated, local/CI-tested, formally_compiled, independently_verified and physically_validated states cannot substitute for one another.
A demonstrated failure has a minimal reproducer, typed cause, invariant, sibling-pattern check, fault injection, preventive regression and prevention evidence.
Idempotency/ambiguity behavior and an isolated rollback/restore preserve exact artifacts and prior evidence.

Simplex, n-ality, continuum and fuzzy lenses are considered with applicability reasons; any chosen transform states typed assumptions, invariant/error mappings and passes original acceptance tests. Authorization and verification remain Boolean.
